targetText: This chapter may be brief. It merely contains the conclusions that may be drawn in regard to the position of woman in future society, from all that has been said so far; conclusions that every reader can easily draw for himself.
summary: Summarizing woman's position in future socialist society, Bebel declares that woman will be socially and economically independent, no longer subjected to any trace of domination or exploitation, free to choose her partner solely on the basis of mutual love and respect.
